newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Italy's Dini seeks meeting on government policy.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Dini seeks meeting on government policy.

text.p: Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini on Saturday called for centre-left parties which support the government to meet to discuss future policy.
"It is right that after seven or eight months in government we draw up the policies (we) must follow in 1997," Dini, who is head of the small Italian Renewal party, told reporters.
Dini is in Ireland for a two-day European Union summit.
He added that he did not see any need for talks over the actual make-up of Prime Minister Romano Prodi's government, which took office in May.
